method: 24 held-out scenarios (the 16 from iteration-1 plus 8 new: items 17-24 add adversarial over-trigger (17), trial-disclosure detail (18), 2FA recovery (19), modality/alert-stacking (20), an iOS-vs-Android divergence (21), nav tab-count (22), a no-fixed-answer honesty trap (23: exact SIWA button width), and magic-link properties (24)). THREE conditions: (1) baseline — own knowledge, no files, n=2; (2) skill_all — read all 6 skills/mobile-ux/*/SKILL.md then answer all 24, n=2 (iteration-1-style upper bound); (3) skill_targeted — 6 mini-runs, each reads ONLY its one owning skill and answers only that skill's item subset (mirrors real-world single-skill loading; measures whether targeted reading keeps the score at a fraction of the file-read tokens). Grading by an INDEPENDENT judge subagent (not the author) applying the truth key below.
grading: Independent judge subagent scores each answer correct/incorrect: correct iff right DECISION and the load-bearing element is present. Adversarial items 17 (over-trigger) and 23 (no fixed answer) are correct only if the agent does NOT fabricate a paywall/number and gives the honest answer. pass_rate = mean over items of correct_runs/n.
